claims.evidence: Physical origin or import history cannot be determined from visual inspection of the exterior.
The witness report identifies two controllers: one camouflage pattern and one plain black.
No photos of the system user interface or storage menu were provided.
These game titles do not exist; the FIFA series ended with FIFA 23 and PES was rebranded years ago.

risks.risk: Internal hardware failure (Blue Light of Death) common in early glossy models.
risks.proof: Video of the console booting to the main menu and running a game for 10 minutes.
risks.if_unproven: As a non-working unit for parts.

risks.risk: Console is banned from PlayStation Network (PSN).
risks.proof: Video showing the console successfully logging into the PlayStation Store.
Video of a disc being inserted, read, and the game launching.
risks.if_unproven: As a digital-only console with a broken drive.

risks.risk: Controller analog stick drift or unresponsive buttons.
risks.proof: Video of the controllers being used to navigate menus or a controller test app.

proof_requests: Photo of the 'System Information' screen showing the software version and storage capacity.
Video of the console running a demanding game to check for fan noise and overheating.
Clear photo of the model number sticker on the rear or bottom of the console.
Photo of the 'Storage' menu to verify the presence and licenses of the 10 claimed games.
response.reason: The seller claims the inclusion of games that do not exist (Fifa 27, Pes 27) and provides a controller count that contradicts the witness's observations.
